label_definitions.target: Everything audible in the unit is the clip's target language. A name, a brand or one borrowed word inside it does not change that.
label_definitions.other: Everything audible is some other language, usually the language the lesson is taught in.
label_definitions.mixed: Both the target language and another language are audible inside this unit, for example 'the word 认识 means to know'.
label_definitions.no_speech: Only music, noise, laughter, breathing or a sound effect; no words at all.
label_definitions.unsure: You replayed it and still cannot tell which language it is, or it is too short to judge.
